posts.text: After  House Republicans rejected a bipartisan bill that would’ve funded TSA and reopened airport security lines nationwide, Speaker of the House Mike Johnson tried to explain the reasoning behind House Republicans’ “no“. Let’s fact check him.  ##tsa##mikejohnson

During the recent CPAC conference of conservative voters, chairman Matt Schlapp tried to get the crowd to boo at the idea that Congress could start impeachment proceedings, but the crowd reacted with a loud cheer, clearly unsure of what impeachment proceedings are.

President Trump told a journalist that it’s OK for him to vote by mail, even though he said that mail in ballots are “cheating“ because he is the president of the United States and, even if he was in Florida recently, he was “busy with many other things“

The Senate passed a bill that will fund TSA through the end of September and reopen airport security across the United States. The bill is now headed for the House of Representatives. This is essentially the same bill that Senator Thune had proposed to Trump, but Trump had rejected saying “no deal with the Democrats“.  if the bill passes, it will also make Trump’s proposed executive order to use DHS funding to pay airport security salaries unnecessary.

A letter written by a man begging not to be deported, has been recently published. The amazing thing is that the man who wrote this letter is Donald Trump’s grandfather, Frederick, Trump, who left Germany and immigrated to the United States without following the law. When he returned to Germany, he found out that his citizenship had been revoked and begged the authorities not to deport him and his family.
Did you know that healthcare providers will charge lower prices for cash patients than for insured patients? This is how the healthcare industry robs American families of their hard earned money.

Speaker of the house Mike Johnson presented Donald Trump with the first ever “America first award” This represents the latest award created seemingly specifically for the current president of the United States and follows the “FIFA Peace prize” and the symbolic gesture by Maria Corina Machado, who presented Trump with her own Nobel Peace Prize

Does the SAVE Act make it harder to vote or harder to cheat? Let’s fact check claims like the ones by @Nicole Hedrick , who says that all you need to do is use a Real ID or get a passport, and also look at what the courts have said about a similar law that was passed in Arizona.  #factcheck #votingrights

What’s happening with the Iran conflict? After President Donald Trump told the press that there had been positive and productive talks with the Iranian government, Iran officially said that no talks and no negotiations had occurred at all.  Can America trust Trump’s version of the facts? #i#iranwarh#hormuz

President Trump, during a press conference, said that the Iran conflict that started February 28 “has been won”. However, all evidence suggest that the conflict is ongoing and, in fact, the U.S. effort is surging.
